fusions.name: Parting Shots
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows in a spread, each dealing 3 piercing damage, and your movement speed rises by 10% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Chase's End
fusions.desc: Looses one arrow at an enemy at or below 25% health that deals 24 piercing damage. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Flight Distance
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Drawn at a Gallop
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
